items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: And his name was Bobby Johnson. He had a lot to do with me, gave me my first horn, bought me my first good horn, a King trumpet

ctx.x: Yes. So that’s one of the ways. Now there are several other stories. I knew during those days that Louis Armstrong was very popular with the ladies you know. It’s easy to keep up with Satch’s age, because he was born in 1900. And frankly I wasn’t too far behind him, I was born in 1915, and my father was what we would call a ragtime piano player. As a matter of fact my father was the one who did the piano roll on “There’ll Be Some Changes Made.” And his name was Bobby Johnson. He had a lot to do with me, gave me…
